title: Framed Panel Upholstered Kids Bed – Children's Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Framed Panel Kids Bed keeps things simple with a single large padded panel framed by layered rectangular borders. It is the easiest of our kids designs to style with any room, fully upholstered and handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop.

Key features

  • Single large padded panel with layered rectangular borders
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Solid, sturdy frame
  • Handmade to order in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size or mattress to choose? Call 07417 439197 before you order, or browse our mattresses.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid, sturdy wood frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches let you check colours at home.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Free delivery applies across Great Britain, by our own team, typically within 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90. Changed your mind? You can return it free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and we collect it. If anything arrives faulty we will replace it or refund you in full. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

Which kids bed is easiest to match to a room?

The Framed Panel is our simplest kids design and the easiest to style with any room.

What sizes does the Framed Panel Kids Bed come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT).

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
